$comment: Editable text in a compose_slideshow spec. Shared source for the CLI (conductor-tools/src/lib/slideshow/text-fields.ts), the web editor and the backend (SlideshowTextFields.java); parity tests on both sides keep them equal. A pattern is a dotted path from one slide, `[]` = any index of that array. A concrete path (`texts[0].t`, `rows[1].items[2]`) is editable when replacing each index with `[]` gives a pattern here AND the value at that path is already a string. Edits only replace existing strings: they never add or remove array entries or create absent fields.
